title.suggested: Why Allen is a Mitchell man

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen picked Charley Mitchell to beat Jim Corbett because both he and Mitchell were born in Birmingham, the same reasoning that led him to back Ed Smith against Joe Goddard.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday Evening, October 21, 1893, page 8, second column.

facts.fact: Allen was born in Birmingham, England
Allen backed Ed Smith, a Birmingham man, against Joe Goddard and won heavily on the bet
Allen predicted Charley Mitchell, also born in Birmingham, would beat Jim Corbett, holding that a Birmingham-born man can always beat one who is not
